name: literature_review

node_types.name: Review
node_types.description: A source-attributed synthesis for a harness question; not a truth certificate.

node_types.name: Paper
node_types.description: A prepared paper identified by its source provenance.

node_types.name: Entity
node_types.description: A concept, object or physical entity discussed in one or more papers.

node_types.name: Method
node_types.description: A method or approximation reported in a paper.

node_types.name: Claim
node_types.description: A statement attributed to a paper; not independently certified.

node_types.name: Gap
node_types.description: An unresolved coverage or evidential obligation.

relation_types.name: reviews
relation_types.description: Review includes a prepared, source-attributed paper.

relation_types.name: discusses
relation_types.description: Source or review discusses the target.

relation_types.name: uses
relation_types.description: Paper reports use of the method.

relation_types.name: about
relation_types.description: Claim or method concerns an entity.

relation_types.name: supports
relation_types.description: Proposed support between attributed claims; entailment is not certified.

relation_types.name: contradicts
relation_types.description: Apparent conflict requiring interpretation, not an adjudicated contradiction.

instructions: Represent paper-attributed statements and shared entities separately. Every node and relation requires exact prepared-region evidence. An attributed claim remains proposed even after the review graph is committed.
